instrument: scripts/stack/run_undistort_pipeline.sh (calibrate -> darktable undistort -> Siril register -2pass -transf=homography, setref lt 1, seqapplyreg -framing=min lanczos4, stack r_lt rej w 3 3 -norm=addscale, no -output_norm) x3 arms; scripts/calibrate/solve_field.py --max-stars=1500 --inject; scripts/qa/shape_at_sky.py --box=800 --top=30 (Siril findstar, open gate) at 7 sky positions from sub_01's own WCS; scripts/qa/star_shape.py (Siril seqtilt); the arm spans read from each arm's own lt_.seq homographies (h02); angles: top-30-by-A axial mean on the doubled angle (Siril's angle is an axis angle mod 180), e-weighted, vs the local +RA direction from the arm's own WCS in y-down convention (y-up reported beside it)
knob: the stacked drift span; held: aug06/set-01 group 1's own frames (DSC_6239..DSC_6338, capture order, no cull), reference frame 1 = DSC_6239 pinned in every arm, 12 frames -> rej w 3 3, masters dark_master.fit + skyflat_set-01.fit, the pinned lens model, the same builder

P.role: 100 consecutive, GESD, span 236 px — not one-knob vs S/M/L

span_note: the ledger's 1.9064 px/frame (raw-frame cross-match) predicted 21/84/189; Siril's 2pass homographies in the UNDISTORTED frame give 2.37 px/frame -> 26.1/104.3/235.7 (ratio 1 : 4.00 : 9.04 = the frame-index ratio 11:44:99); the undistorted frame's scale (lensfun autoscale) is the difference; L's canvas equals sub_01's (5830x3951) as the same span + reference + framing=min require
exit_side: negative dx (low x, low RA): RA increases with +x on sub_01's WCS, so on the fixed mount the sliding RA window carries a star toward -x — stars enter right, leave left; the ledger's measured drift direction on this set agrees

verdict.reading: H_reg (exit-edge registration) NOT SUPPORTED: across a 9x change of stacked drift span (26 -> 236 px) the exit-side blur at matched sensor position is flat — dFWHM(L-S) -0.025 / -0.002 / +0.055 px and dround(S-L) -0.005 / +0.018 / -0.008 at dx -2400/-1800/-1200; the S<M<L ordering holds at one exit station of three (dx-1200) and is reversed at dx-2400 (S the worst); the kill rule for H_fixed does not fire (largest exit dFWHM 0.055 < 0.10, largest dround 0.018 < 0.03, and the entry side is not flat). H_fixed's literal +-0.05 px flatness is exceeded by 0.005 px at ONE exit station (dx-1200, +0.055; the other two -0.025 / -0.002; roundness within 0.018 everywhere) and FAILS outright at the far ENTRY station: dx+2400 FWHM rises monotonically with span, S 2.465 -> M 2.485 -> L 2.550 (+0.085 px), roundness 0.875 -> 0.870 -> 0.859 — a span dependence on the side neither hypothesis placed it (the ledger's lens-asymmetry side). By the pre-registered rules: NEITHER, reported as measured — the exit-edge registration hypothesis is refuted for the exit-side blur; the span-dependent term is on the entry (right) side, where the optics' own ellipticity is largest (top-30 median e 0.13-0.15 vs 0.06-0.08 on the left) and NOT drift-aligned (major axis 27-48 deg from the local +RA direction vs 2-12 deg on the exit side).
verdict.angle_prediction: H_reg predicted the exit-side major axis drift-aligned in L and losing alignment in S. MEASURED: the exit-side stations are drift-aligned at EVERY span — dx-1200 deviation from +RA (y-down) S 1.9 / M 3.8 / L 5.0 / P 6.7 deg, dx-1800 S 9.8 / M 9.6 / L 10.5 / P 12.2 deg, concentration R 0.78-0.98 — S does not lose the alignment; dx-2400's angle is ill-defined (median e 0.02-0.03, R 0.04-0.30). Entry side: 11-37 deg off +RA on every arm, R 0.69-0.95, e 0.11-0.15 — the elongation there is not the drift direction.
verdict.L_vs_P_depth_and_rejection_at_fixed_span: FWHM within 0.012 px at every station (P-L: +0.012, +0.007, -0.005, +0.011, +0.007, +0.005, +0.002) and roundness within 0.009 except dx-2400 (+0.006) and dx+2400 (+0.009); 100 frames GESD vs 12 winsorized at the same 236-px span changes nothing the instrument resolves. seqtilt: P 2.64 / 0.17 / 0.25 on 22,097 stars vs S 2.53 / 0.16 / 0.20, M 2.54 / 0.16 / 0.18, L 2.54 / 0.16 / 0.19 on 11.4-11.7k — the whole-frame numbers are flat across spans; P's higher truncated mean rides its deeper detection (the detection-depth trap), not a like-for-like comparison.
verdict.mechanism_offered_MECHANISM_not_measured: a fixed sensor-coordinate PSF field plus span AVERAGING: a matched sky position is built from frames in which that sky sat at sensor x, x+step, ..., x+span, so the stacked PSF is the lens PSF averaged over that sensor range — flat where the PSF gradient is small (the exit/left side here) and growing with span where it is steep (the far right, where the top-30 ellipticity climbs 0.11 -> 0.15 between +1800 and +2400). Testable with the same arms: the +2400 station's FWHM(L) should equal the mean of the single-frame PSF over [x, x+236]. Not run.

premises_untested: that the 2pass homography's h02 (per-frame x translation in the 2pass's own reference frame) is the stacked span — the relative spans (1:4:9) are exact, the absolute scale is the undistorted frame's, not the raw frame's

that matched SKY (sub_01's WCS) is matched SENSOR position across arms: all three arms pin the same reference frame and framing=min, so the reference frame's sensor geometry is the canvas of every arm; the arm's own solve places the box (box_center_offset 0.11-0.39 deg = the tool's own verification), residual solve-to-solve differences are inside an 800-px box

the y-down convention for the +RA direction (the y-up variant is recorded beside every angle; the drift axis is 2-15 deg from horizontal, so the ambiguity is <= 30 deg at the far stations and <= 12 deg on the exit side)
the major-axis rule (angle when FWHMx >= FWHMy, else +90) — moot here: FWHMx >= FWHMy for every top-30 star at every station on every arm (fraction 0.0)
that 30 stars per station resolve 0.05 px: the between-arm scatter at flat stations is 0.002-0.03 px, consistent with that; no bootstrap was run
the +2400 entry-side rise is one station on one set; the span-averaging mechanism offered is MECHANISM, not measured
